async def act(page):
    # Target article title
    target_title = "Pope Leo urges 'courage' to end Ukraine war in first Christmas address"
    
    # Use filter_pages_by_content_type to get links from the homepage
    links_by_type = await filter_pages_by_content_type(page, '/')
    
    # Extract post URLs from the result
    post_links = links_by_type.get('post', [])
    if not post_links:
        # If no posts found, return a message
        return "No post links found on the homepage."
    
    # Iterate through each post link
    for link_info in post_links:
        url = link_info.get('url')
        if not url:
            continue
        try:
            # Navigate to the post URL
            await page.goto(url, wait_until='domcontentloaded')
            await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)  # Wait for content to load
            
            # Check if the page title contains the target title
            page_title = await page.title()
            if target_title.lower() in page_title.lower():
                return url  # Found the article, return the URL
            
            # Alternatively, check the main content for the title
            main_element = page.get_by_role('main')
            if await main_element.count() > 0:
                main_text = await main_element.text_content()
                if target_title.lower() in main_text.lower():
                    return url
            
            # Go back to homepage for next iteration
            await page.goto('/', wait_until='domcontentloaded')
        except Exception as e:
            # If navigation fails, skip this URL and continue
            print(f"Error navigating to {url}: {e}")
            try:
                await page.goto('/', wait_until='domcontentloaded')
            except:
                pass
    
    # If not found, return a message
    return "Article not found in the explored post pages."
